observed.scope: existing VALID forwards only; last active observed event per input history, separately for each layer
observed.phase_statistics: instantaneous pre-accumulation increments; not accumulated theta or counterfactual model outputs
observed.bf16_scope: COUNTERFACTUAL raw-angle BF16 cast only; native MIMO angles stay FP32. Actual Q/K rotation casting is downstream and not measured by these counters
observed.raw_correction_scope: shared across heads; correction stats count each angle once, native increments count each head
observed.sampling: first eight active histories per layer; no randomness; exact aggregate counters cover all selected last queries
observed.interpretation: frequency contribution, correction size and saturation are diagnostics, not causal feature importance

parameters.sharing: one W shared across both layers and both heads

gradients.scope: last available TRAIN backward at VALID boundary; not all optimizer steps

parameters.saturation_definition: abs(tanh(W phi)) >= 0.99; descriptive counter, not acceptance threshold
parameters.grids_scope: fixed analytic inputs only; no dataset or model evaluation; absolute grid is Unix day0 in UTC, not user local time
parameters.grid_active_policy: all grid entries active, including hour0; separate gate verifies first/padding neutrality
parameters.raw_angle_dtype: native MIMO FP32; BF16 raw-angle comparisons below are counterfactual only
parameters.frequency_contribution_definition: W_pair phi_pair before shared tanh; post-tanh contributions are not additive

train_coverage_summary.scope: fixed TRAIN input-history sample; all valid positions in each sampled window
train_coverage_summary.decision_rule: finite exact integer positive Unix milliseconds; active events with nonconstant exact phases for each period; range >=24h and >=2 UTC dates as conservative identifiability checks. No phase-bin occupancy or metric-based threshold.

parameters.interpretation: W norm or a nonzero frequency contribution does not establish importance, behavioural periodicity or personal local-time habits.
